reReview.why: PR #72 (D-colour, "Match players") decodes BT.709 footage at its true, darker values. The owner's G1 and ET7a judgements were made on footage lifted by up to 16 levels.

reReview.renders: All 16 render SHA-256s changed (the footage decode); all validate with strict coverage covered; all lint with status passed and no errors.

fixes.symptom: ET7a b03 r01: font-metadata 'invalid name string extent'; name ID 13 licence is 8,716 bytes (Windows) / 4,358 (Mac), over the 2,048-byte budget.
fixes.fix: readFontNames decodes only identity name IDs (1, 2, 4, 6, 16, 17); every record is still extent-checked and identity names keep the 2 KB budget.
fixes.failingFirst: tests/unit/font-identity.test.ts: Prompt Black identity; a malformed copyright string is skipped; an identity name over 2 KB and a skipped record past the table still fail.
fixes.evidence: comp validate --font-coverage strict on a Prompt Black probe: main fails (font-metadata), branch valid; comp measure loads it in the browser (Prompt / Black). Prompt Black joins the pilot's Thai fonts; probes/all-fonts.ts valid.
fixes.pixels: none: identities of fonts that loaded before are unchanged

fixes.symptom: ET7a a02 r01: a span style in static Pinyon inherited the base style's wght 900 (comp-text-font-axis; also font-axis-range in the font gate); workaround axes: {}.
fixes.fix: spanStyleOver: a span style that sets no axes keeps an inherited axis only where its own font has it. Used by validation, animator axis checks, copy runs (font gate), shaping, font loading and axis variants. Inherited axes the font has are still range-checked; explicit span axes must exist.
fixes.failingFirst: tests/unit/composition-span-axes.test.ts; browser group editorial-titles-phase1 (span measured in Pinyon; render equals the axes: {} workaround byte for byte).
fixes.pixels: none: a scene that rendered before had every inherited axis on the span font (loading threw otherwise)

fixes.symptom: ET7a b06 r01-r03: the highlight showed in full behind the first typed glyph (fadeWithText follows the line's highest glyph opacity); reveal keyed by hand, lint caught 2.03:1.
fixes.fix: Opt-in decoration field growWithText: each line's mark covers only non-blank glyphs whose animator opacity and scale are above 0. Used by drawing and the orphaned-decoration guard.
fixes.failingFirst: editorial-titles-phase1: mid-typing the box ends 35 px past the opaque ink with growWithText, 164 px without; fully typed and unanimated renders identical; unit carry-through test.
fixes.pixels: none by default (opt-in); comp measure reports the settled state and is unchanged
fixes.found: A text animator's end bounds the whole build (unit starts clamp to end - 1); the pilot's enter(duration 2, stagger 2) typed b06 in about 2 frames. Noted in the skill.

fixes.symptom: ET7a engine mapping: highlights have no horizontal padding; only thickness controls the band.
fixes.fix: Opt-in decoration field padding (CSS order: n, [vertical, horizontal], [top, right, bottom, left]) on highlight and box; a highlight band grows about its unpadded centre. Drawing, dirty and native text bounds and comp measure (paint box, resolved padding) share one geometry. Underline/strike reject it (comp-text-decoration-padding).
fixes.failingFirst: tests/unit/composition-decoration-padding.test.ts; editorial-titles-phase1: measured paint box grows by exactly the padding; rendered edges within 0.8 px.
fixes.pixels: none: unpadded marks compute exactly as before

fixes.symptom: ET7a: light.glow has no colour; the pilot faked coloured halos with a zero-offset drop shadow.
fixes.fix: light.glow 1.1.0: color (default white) and tint (0-1, default 0); tint blends each glowing pixel's colour toward color and its weight toward full coverage. Canvas and WebGL2; comp measure strength follows.
fixes.failingFirst: editorial-titles-phase1: lavender ring around dark caps on both backends (Canvas vs WebGL2 worst difference 0); tint 0 equals 1.0.0 params on both; unit tests for version and measure strength.
fixes.pixels: none for existing glows: a 1.0.0-parameter glow renders byte-identically to main on Canvas and WebGL2 (frame SHA-256 dbb2c328... / a98d07bb...). Pinned changes: WebGL2 built-in trace hashes for light.glow (shader text) and evaluated glow params now list tint and color defaults. Export snapshots record effect version 1.1.0.
fixes.limit: A screened glow only lightens; dark halos stay zero-offset drop shadows (skill and grammar say so).

affectedBaselines: None. No renderer version changed; composition baselines, ET0 and catalogue baselines are unaffected (see verification). Pinned non-pixel expectations updated: light.glow WebGL2 trace hashes and evaluated params.

reviewFixes.method: Review of the PR head 6deeee68 on three axes (repo standards, the Phase 1 spec, correctness), one inline comment per finding (17). Code findings fixed one commit each; the rest recorded below without a change.

fixed.finding: growWithText baseline follows the first revealed glyph
fixed.fix: A growing mark follows its line's most-revealed glyph (first on ties); settled frames and non-growing marks unchanged. Failing-first unit test.

fixed.finding: light.glow color without tint renders nothing new
fixed.fix: Validation rejects color with tint omitted (comp-effect-params at params.color); an explicit tint, even 0 or keyed, is accepted. Failing-first unit test; reference notes updated.
Typed as the schema's number, pair or four-tuple; unit test pins the three forms.
padSegment, decorationBand (with bottom) and decorationBoxBand shared by drawing, bounds and measure; drawing and measure arithmetic unchanged.

fixed.finding: glow colour clamp and tint weight duplicated
fixed.fix: glowColorBytes() and glowWeight() in pixel-effects.ts; pinned WebGL2 trace hashes unchanged.
One declaredFontAxes over any fonts or assets; pinnedFontAxes and font-copy's re-export removed. loadedFontAxes kept: it reads loaded font metrics.
resolvedTextStyle overloads require the lookup with a span style; case-only callers pass undefined explicitly.
Takes a DecorationSelection (the mark); bounds pass { span } alone to cover every frame.
